messages:
Tom (Sales): Quick handoff for TwinWave — they want to move from hosted eval to a private deployment (Q2 target). Renewal in ~11 months, they're sensitive to KMS/HSM and SSO. TL;DR + asks below.
Aisha (CSM): thanks Tom — copying here. Can you paste their current prod-like usage and any compliance docs they shared?
Tom (Sales): Usage: ~15M tokens/month (30% chat, 70% generation), peak bursts ~20 TPS for short requests. Currently testing on hosted with small models. Compliance: SOC2 doc from their security team attached in the original email (link dropped in DM). Primary contact: Rachel Park (rachel@twinwave.ai).
Maya (Onboarding PM): Do they require SCIM provisioning or just SSO? Also need to know if they want SP-initiated or IdP-initiated flow.
Tom (Sales): They use Okta, want SCIM + SP-initiated SSO. They also asked about session timeout and Just-in-Time group sync.
Diego (Support Eng): Noted. Will they need private VPC peering + IP allowlist? If so we need their CIDR ranges and whether they want site-to-site VPN or AWS VPC peering. Also is TLS termination on their side?
Tom (Sales): They prefer VPC peering (AWS) and will provide CIDRs. TLS will terminate at our edge, but HSM/KMS requests need to originate from private network.
Lena (Solutions Eng): For a private PoC I can stand up a 2xA100 equivalent node for 1 week. Need to know model family & weight access. Are they planning to serve an LLM from the open family (e.g., Llama2-70B quantized) or bring their own fine-tuned weights?
Tom (Sales): They plan to bring a fine-tuned Llama2-70B quantized weights (internal), but can test with our curated model first.
Diego (Support Eng): Please attach sample terraform/vpc config. Quick snippet I usually ask for:
```
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "peer" {
  vpc_id        = "vpc-XXXX"
  peer_vpc_id   = "vpc-YYYY"
  auto_accept   = true
}
```
Diego (Support Eng): Also need an approver for network access from their infra team and a contact for HSM/KMS enablement (who will sign off on key exchange).
Aisha (CSM): I'm going to create the onboarding doc in /cs/onboarding/twinwave and capture these items. Proposed owners + next steps: 1) Security & architecture review — owner: Diego (Support Eng) — due: 2026-04-05. 2) SSO + SCIM setup — owner: Maya (Onboarding PM) — due: 2026-03-29. 3) Private PoC infra & model staging — owner: Lena (Solutions Eng) — due: 2026-04-09. 4) Commercial and committed sizing — owner: Tom (Sales) — due: 2026-03-25. 5) Customer enablement session (30m) & feedback capture — owner: Aisha (CSM) — schedule by 2026-03-27.
Aisha (CSM): Risk note — renewal in 11 months, competitors already engaged. We should prioritize performance metrics (latency at 20 TPS, tail p99) in the PoC and surface cost/latency tradeoffs in the enablement call.
Lena (Solutions Eng): I'll need a sample input distribution (avg tokens per request, typical prompt types) to size KV cache and batching. Can Rachel share a 1-page sample prompt set?
Tom (Sales): I'll ask Rachel for that and forward to Aisha + Lena.
onboard-bot: Created onboarding doc /cs/onboarding/twinwave and added owners list.
Maya (Onboarding PM): I'll tentatively book a 30-min kickoff for next week; will send calendar invite once we have sample prompts.
Diego (Support Eng): I'll kick off the internal security checklist and ping EngSec for HSM process. Owner: Diego, ETA: 2026-04-05.
Aisha (CSM): All agreed? Please react with :thumbsup: if you accept the owners/dates or reply with changes.
Tom (Sales): :thumbsup:
Lena (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup:
Diego (Support Eng): :white_check_mark: starting security ticket now.
Aisha (CSM): Great — I'll follow up with a summary doc and link to the onboarding page. We'll route any escalations to eng-oncall if HSM/VPC proves blocked.
Tom (Sales): Thanks team, keeping customer warm. I'll post any customer responses here as they come in.
Aisha (CSM): closing loop — next sync after sample prompts arrive.
